queries.sql: SELECT `news`.*, `categories`.`name` as `category_name`, `categories`.`type` as `category_type`, `sub_cats`.`name` as `sub_category_name`, `districts`.`name` as `district_name`, `mandals`.`name` as `mandal_name`, `villages`.`name` as `village_name`, `users`.`display_name` as `reporter_name`, `users`.`profile_pic` as `reporter_image`, `users`.`area_coverage` as `reporter_area` FROM `news` LEFT JOIN `categories` ON `categories`.`id` = `news`.`category_id` LEFT JOIN `categories` as `sub_cats` ON `sub_cats`.`id` = `news`.`sub_category_id` LEFT JOIN `categories` as `districts` ON `districts`.`id` = `news`.`district_id` LEFT JOIN `categories` as `mandals` ON `mandals`.`id` = `news`.`mandal_id` LEFT JOIN `categories` as `villages` ON `villages`.`id` = `news`.`village_id` LEFT JOIN `users` ON `users`.`id` = `news`.`author_id` WHERE `news`.`slug` = 'death-that-wont-leave-even-after-the-debt-is-paid-7614' AND `news`.`status` = 1 LIMIT 1
